p: he entered again into the synagogue: Thirdly, because they preferred the ceremonial law (which was but an addition to the moral law) before the moral law, whereas in reality they should have learned from this the true use of the ceremonial law.
withered hand: That is, unprofitable and dead.
life: He uses here the figure of speech called synecdoche, for this type of saying, "to save the life", is the same as saying "to save the man".

with anger: Men are angry when they have wrong done to them, but not without sin: but Christ is angry without sin, and he is not sorry for the injury that is done to him as much as he is for their wickedness; and therefore he had pity upon them, and because of that he is said to have been grieved.
hardness of their hearts: As though their heart had been closed up and had grown together, so that wholesome doctrine had no effect upon them.
And the Pharisees went forth: The more the truth is suppressed, the more it comes out.
Herodians against him: See Mt 22:16.
beyond Jordan: Which Josephus called stony or rocky.
wait on him because of the: Should always be ready for him.
plagues: Diseases with which God scourges men as it were with whips.
unclean spirits: In those whom they had entered into: or by the figure of speech called metonymy, it refers to those who were vexed with the unclean spirits.
And he: The twelve apostles are set apart to be trained for the office of the apostleship.
ordained twelve: Chose and appointed twelve to be familiar and well acquainted with him.
Thaddaeus: Whom Luke also calls Judas: and to make a distinction the other Judas is called Iscariot.
house: The disciples whom Christ had taken as part of his company and to live with him come home to his house, to be with him from this point on.
And when his: None are worse enemies of the gospel than they that should be enemies of it the least.
friends heard of it: Literally, "they that were of him", that is, his relatives: for they that were mad were brought to their relatives.
Satan rise up against himself: Satan's servants or followers.
Verily I say unto you: Only those who know Christ and maliciously attack him are without hope of salvation.
Because they said: These are the words of the evangelist.
brethren and his mother: By the name "brother" the Hebrews understand all that are of the same stock and blood.
And he looked round about on: The spiritual family is larger than the biological family.
